# Rubric and gates

## Rubric

Score 1–5. Never change the criteria in the middle of a project.

| Criterion | Question |
| --- | --- |
| Core verb | Is one action satisfying on its own? |
| Testability | Can the core be proven fun in one room or encounter? |
| Scope fit | Can a slice exist in 2–4 weeks of evenings? |
| Art feasibility | Can I draw it at the quality it needs? |
| Distinctiveness | Is the delta from the reference nameable in one sentence? |
| Pull | Do I want to open the project tomorrow? |

## Gates

| Gate | Pass | Kill |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Concept | One concept, core question, dated loser list | No testable core question |
| Ready to prototype | Prototype question and kill criterion written | Neither can be written |
| Fun | Prototype answers yes; I want to play it again | Kill criterion met |
| Slice done | Testers retry by choice; deaths feel fair | — |
